name: Reqall
author: Reqall
description: Your Reqall memory at a glance: recent records, open work, and account status in a native Omarchy bar panel, plus a Remember form to add a record.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: recent memories, open todos and issues, project count, and sign-in when you need it.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: brain and head-cog are monochrome Nerd Font glyphs; emoji is the colour 🧠.

schema.label: API key
schema.description: Optional. A Reqall API key (rq_...). When empty the widget uses REQALL_API_KEY, ~/.config/reqall/env, or the reqall CLI's stored login.

schema.label: Server URL
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to REQALL_URL or https://www.reqall.net.

schema.label: Project filter
schema.description: Optional exact Reqall project name, e.g. acme/notes or .machine/host/user. Empty means account-wide; no name is inferred from directories.
